questions.question: If the CRO’s amplitude control is increased, the waveform will:

explanations.b: Increasing the amplitude control makes the waveform taller, reflecting a higher voltage.

questions.question: During the VR CRO experiment, changing the amplitude control affects:

answers.d: The time period of the signal

explanations.b: Changing the amplitude affects how the waveform fits vertically on the CRO screen.

questions.question: If the signal generator outputs a triangular waveform, the CRO display will show:

answers.c: A linearly rising and falling waveform

explanations.c: A triangular waveform rises and falls linearly, unlike sine or square waves.

questions.question: In the VR CRO, the measured peak voltage is half of:

explanations.b: The peak voltage is half of the peak-to-peak voltage.

questions.question: In the VR CRO lab, a signal frequency increases. On the display, the waveform will:

explanations.b: : Increasing the signal frequency reduces the time period, so the waveform compresses horizontally.

questions.question: The advantage of doing amplitude measurements in VR CRO is:

answers.c: It removes the need for volts/div control

explanations.a: In a VR CRO lab, amplitude measurements can be done safely and virtually, without using physical probes.
